title: Scale curve
description: The lightness of each step of a scheme's key scale, the curve the scheme's step answer gives, and a linear curve for comparison. Drawn by the ScaleCurve composite on How the scale is built.

hue.description: The hue of the key scale, such as pink or blue.

key.description: The key step: the key color sits exact here.

option.description: The label of the scheme's answer to color.definition.steps, from the grammar.

easing.description: The easing strength of that answer: 0 is linear, 1 is full smoothstep.

band.description: The middle band: the steps an ease spreads wider than a linear curve.

from.description: The first step of the middle band.

to.description: The last step of the middle band.

wider.description: The largest lightness gap between two neighbor middle steps, as a multiple of the linear curve's gap.

step.description: The step of the scale, 50 to 950.

hex.description: The color as built, in uppercase hex.

lightness.description: The OKLCH lightness of the built step.

curve.description: The OKLCH lightness the scheme's curve gives the step, before any hold.

linear.description: The OKLCH lightness a linear curve (easing 0) gives the step.

held.description: Present when the step keeps its earlier value: the reason it is held.

curveHex.description: For a held step: the color the curve would give it.
